field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Empty because this task invokes no LLM.
field_principles.down_up_kernel_ready_score: One requires correct finite-law transitions and effective negative controls.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic work time; do not pad it to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_host: Put the actual hostname here, never inside execution_venue.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use exactly host, kv260, gatemate or polarfire; these tasks execute on host.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo the reason for each field beside its actual evidence.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* verdict names failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings; blocked_* for external absence. Readiness is not scientific value.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the intended workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The actual operation determines its duration floor.
field_principles.kernel_cost_contract: All replacement-candidate energies and normalization work are charged.
field_principles.model_invoked: False; upstream inference is only cited.
field_principles.mutation_rows: Independent laws must reject deliberately incorrect transitions.
field_principles.paper_assumption_rows: The SK ensemble theorem does not automatically apply to arbitrary local graphs.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record the actual resource, code and gate observations.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze stochastic choices before held-out outcomes are read.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash the inputs, code, settings and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Keep unit_id, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for each comparison; do not replace numeric rows with a task roster.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260911; do not substitute an upstream experiment date.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Retain planned, attempted, completed, censored and independent-unit counts.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind source code, input data and frozen contracts to the claim.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal artifact only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.transition_rows: Each enumerated cell records stationarity and detailed-balance residuals.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial; only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Same correctness authority remains circular even with a separate implementation.
